verdicts.ELIGIBLE: Meets every published requirement that can be checked from the results.
verdicts.AT_RISK: May qualify, but something can't be confirmed: an awaited result, official sources that disagree, or a minimum that isn't published.
verdicts.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Fails at least one published requirement.
verdicts.NO_DATA: The course isn't covered, so no verdict should be given.

note: Each expected verdict was set by an independent Claude agent that read only the original sources in data/raw/ (JAMB IBASS data and brochures, the universities own notices and PDFs). It was not allowed to read the catalog, the seed, the app code or the logs. The human delegated this step. Every evidence quote was checked by script against its raw file.

cases.title: UI Medicine, strong single sitting, UTME 290
cases.tests: UI publishes no UTME minimum for 2026/2027.
cases.reasoning: Every checkable requirement is met: one sitting with credits in English, Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and the UTME subjects match. But UI has published no 2026/2027 minimum UTME score. Its notice gives none, and its cut-off list has only unexplained aggregate marks. Only JAMB's national floor of 150 exists, which 290 clears. Under the stated rule an unpublished minimum gives AT_RISK. If JAMB's 150 is taken as the operative minimum, the answer would be ELIGIBLE.

cases.title: UI Computer Science, 5 credits across two sittings
cases.tests: UI asks for 5 credits at one sitting or 6 at two sittings.
cases.reasoning: UI Computer Science needs 5 credits at one sitting, or 6 at two sittings including English, Maths, Chemistry, Physics and one other science. WAEC alone fails (Chemistry D7), so the six-credit two-sitting rule applies, and UI's 2026 notice says those six must be in relevant subjects. Relevant credits are English, Maths, Physics, Geography (a UI science) and NECO Chemistry, only five. Civic Education is not on UI's Senate-approved list of matriculating subjects. If Civic were counted, the result would still be only AT_RISK, because UI publishes no 2026/27 UTME minimum.
